import random, sys, time, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from refplan import ref_exhaustive
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
tmpl=(b'\xaa'*8).hex(); kinds='KKKDZQTK'
def gen(rng,nf=22,nn=8,cap=4,plen=(2,3),cvals=(1,2,3,4),pin=0,warm=0):
    nodes=['v%02d'%i for i in range(nn)]
    caps=dict((n,cap) for n in nodes)
    flows=[];offers={}
    for i in range(nf):
        k=rng.randint(*plen)
        path=rng.sample(nodes,k)
        fid='f%02d'%i
        flows.append(dict(id=fid,path=path,template=tmpl,kinds=kinds))
        runs=[]
        for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
            h=bytearray(b'\xaa'*8); h[3]=rng.randint(0,255); h[5]=rng.randint(0,7); h[6]=k+rng.randint(0,2)
            if rng.random()<0.15: h[0]^=0xff
            if rng.random()<0.15: h[5]=rng.randint(8,200)
            runs.append(dict(header=bytes(h).hex(),count=rng.choice(cvals)))
        offers[fid]=runs
    ids=[f['id'] for f in flows]
    return dict(mode='plan',capacities=caps,flows=flows,warmup=warm,pinned=rng.sample(ids,min(pin,len(ids))),offers=offers)
rng=random.Random(9)
bad=0
for t in range(25):
    req=gen(rng, cap=rng.choice([3,4,5]), pin=rng.randint(0,3), warm=rng.choice([0,0,1,2]))
    st=time.time(); ref=ref_exhaustive(req); t1=time.time()-st
    st=time.time(); got=m.respond(req); t2=time.time()-st
    if ref.get('infeasible') or got.get('infeasible'):
        print('inf'); 
        if ref!=got: print('INF MISMATCH'); bad+=1
        continue
    same = ref['saved']==got['saved'] and len(ref['selected'])==len(got['selected'])
    print('t%02d ref %8d/%2d (%.2fs) mine %8d/%2d (%.3fs) %s'%(t,ref['saved'],len(ref['selected']),t1,got['saved'],len(got['selected']),t2,'OK' if same else 'MISMATCH'))
    if not same: bad+=1; print(json.dumps(req))
print('bad',bad)
PYEOF
